This is an unresolved reporting gap, not a demonstrated numerical error. The existing null sd_level appropriately reflects the same uncertainty.

summary: Checked all three paired personalized-versus-standard GAI estimates. Read the complete c041 markdown through its references; the chapter has no appendix. Also read the cited related c246 report through its appendix to check the design and aggregation evidence. All 18 non-null statistical values and all nine estimate participant-count fields agree with the cited c041 PDF pages and belong to the correct outcomes and arms. The counts describe the same 62 people completing both conditions, counted once in n_total. Three not_found entries flag one unresolved issue repeated across the estimates: the participant analysis unit is inferred, while aggregation of multiple solutions is not reported. The other requested outcome and contrast codes are consistent with the paper; no numerical SE, CI or test statistic is printed for these creativity contrasts. Randomized feedback sequence is explicit in c246 Fig. 3, conditional on the extraction’s documented shared-sample inference. No in-scope c041 outcome or contrast is missing: quality, elaboration and originality are all included, and no first-round-only result is reported. Self-efficacy, eye-tracking measures and within-condition associations are correctly excluded. The positive printed originality r is preserved despite the lower personalized mean, and no statistics from c246 were substituted.
